description: This file defines the Config class in Drupal, which manages configuration objects including runtime overrides, data access, saving, deleting, and handling overrides at module and settings levels.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents a configuration object in Drupal, supporting overrides, data management, persistence, and event dispatching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Config object with name, storage, event dispatcher, and typed config manager.

methods.name: initWithData
methods.description: Initializes the configuration with provided data and resets overrides.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data by key, supporting nested keys.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the configuration data and resets overrides.

methods.name: setSettingsOverride
methods.description: Sets overrides from settings.php for this configuration object.

methods.name: setModuleOverride
methods.description: Sets module-level overrides for this configuration object.

methods.name: setOverriddenData
methods.description: Combines stored data with module and settings overrides to produce effective data.

methods.name: resetOverriddenData
methods.description: Clears the overridden data cache to force re-computation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration key-value pair and resets overrides.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes a configuration key and resets overrides.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates, casts, and persists the configuration, dispatching save events.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the configuration object and dispatches delete events.

methods.name: getOriginal
methods.description: Retrieves the original data before overrides, optionally applying overrides.

methods.name: hasOverrides
methods.description: Checks if there are overrides for the entire configuration or a specific key.
